fields.title: Capsuleers or Organizations
fields.description: Either the capsuleer who must own the ship being remote boosted, or an organization they must belong to (corporation, alliance, faction).
fields.description_en: Either the capsuleer who must own the ship being remote boosted, or an organization they must belong to (corporation, alliance, faction).
fields.description_de: Entweder der Kapselpilot, der das Schiff besitzt, das per Fernbooster verstärkt wird, oder eine Organisation, der er angehört (Corporation, Allianz, Fraktion).

fields.description_fr_fr: Soit le capsulier qui possède le vaisseau rechargé à distance, soit une organisation à laquelle il doit appartenir (corporation, alliance, faction).

fields.description_zh_hans: 可以是必须拥有进行远程增量的舰船的克隆飞行员，也可以是他们必定在为之效力的的组织（军团、联盟、势力）。
